about: Answers of the C++ client itself, recorded by generate_cpp.py from the program built from cpp_reference.cpp and common/src/crypto.cpp. 'input' is the text in hex, so that white space and bytes that are not UTF-8 survive. 'phrases': valid = validate_seed_phrase(input); for the valid ones, seed and public_key = derive_keypair(input) and fingerprint = public_key_fingerprint(public_key). 'hex_keys': valid = secret_key_from_hex(input), public_key = derive_pubkey of the decoded key.
